lines.say: blocks both enzymes that turn testosterone into DHT; blood DHT falls 85% to 95%
enlarged-prostate symptoms ease; urinary retention and surgery less likely
hair counts rose more than with finasteride (3 trials, 24 weeks; off-label)
PSA falls by about half; any confirmed rise from its lowest is evaluated
semen volume, sperm count and motility fell after a year; fertility effect unknown
erection, desire and ejaculation problems; some may persist after stopping
breast enlargement or tenderness; male breast cancer reported after approval
more high-grade prostate cancer (1.0% versus 0.5% on placebo)
depressed mood reported; suicidal thoughts added to EU labels as a precaution
